name: Sandbag Shouldering
steps: Stand straddling a heavy sandbag, hinge with a flat back and bent knees, and wrap both hands tightly underneath its middle.
Drive through your feet to lap the bag onto your thighs, hug it tight to your chest, and reset your back flat.
Extend your hips and knees explosively upward to heave the sandbag cleanly up onto one shoulder.
Stand tall to lock out the lift, lower the sandbag safely back to the floor, and alternate shoulders on each repetition.
tips: Keep the heavy bag hugged tight against your torso throughout the pull rather than letting it drift forward.
Drive the lift with explosive hip extension instead of rounding your lower back.
